## Intent
Flatten the Saga workspace from nine equal top tabs to three: Übersicht (play hub with sessions + ensemble), Welt (content subtabs: places, NSCs, items, quests, lore), Einstellungen. Match Library Tabs chrome. Keep deep-link URLs working via redirects into the new shells.

## Preconditions
- User is authenticated and a saga member (e.g. Dornhain `SA-E979J`)
- Adaptive shell / `@container/main` available
- Existing section routes under `/sagas/:id/<section>` still resolve

- [ ] `/sagas/:id/npc-creatures|items|quests|lore` open Welt shell with the matching subtab active; top nav highlights Welt
